app.name: Aurum Panel
onboarding.intro.first: You signed in with a temporary password. Set a permanent one and pick a nickname — that is how your colleagues will see you in internal messages.
onboarding.intro.reset: Your password was reset and you signed in with a temporary one. Set a permanent password — your nickname stays as it is, you remain {nickname}.
onboarding.nickname.placeholder: What your colleagues will call you
onboarding.nickname.taken: That nickname is taken — pick another one
onboarding.nickname.hint: Letters and digits; spaces, hyphens and underscores are allowed. This is your staff nickname in the panel and has nothing to do with your in-game name. Changing it later requires the owner's permission.
language.title: Panel language
language.description: Affects only what you see: labels, hints and error messages. Server settings, player names and file contents are not translated.
language.systemHint: The panel follows your browser language and changes along with it.
servers.title: Servers
servers.reorderHint: Drag the cards to set the order. It is saved for you only — your colleagues keep their own list.
servers.empty: No servers available. Run a sync, or ask the owner to grant you access.
servers.notFound: Nothing found. Try a different word.
server.module.missing: No module assigned, or it is disabled — the tabs are unavailable.
server.noTabs: No tabs available to your role.
network.title: Server addresses
network.hint: The port is assigned automatically from the node's free pool — Pterodactyl does not let you pick a specific one. The primary allocation is the one the server announces to players.
network.notePlaceholder: What this port is for: Dynmap, RCON, spare…
startup.command.hint: It cannot be changed from here — that is how Pterodactyl works: the command is edited by the administrator of Pterodactyl itself. It is shown so you can see what the variables below add up to.
startup.image.hint: The list comes from the server's egg. Changing the image is the usual way to change the Java version: it applies on the next start.
startup.image.changed: Image changed — it will apply the next time the server starts
startup.variables.empty: This server's egg exposes no variables.
startup.notEditable: · the egg does not allow changing this
databases.title: Databases
databases.confirmDelete: Delete database {name} together with all its data?
databases.name: Database name
databases.name.hint: Latin letters, digits, hyphen and underscore. Pterodactyl will add its own prefix to the name.
databases.allowed.hint: «%» means from anywhere. If only the server itself needs the database, enter its address.
backups.title: Backups
backups.nameHint: Without a name Pterodactyl uses the date. A clear name helps a lot once you have a dozen backups.
backups.ignore: What to leave out of the backup (optional)
backups.ignoreHint: Patterns as in .gitignore, one per line.
backups.restoreWarning: Restoring cannot be undone. The server will be stopped and the current files replaced with the contents of the backup from {date}. Everything created after that moment will be lost.
files.notEditable: This file cannot be opened in the editor — download it instead
files.tooBig: «{name}» is larger than {limit} — the panel does not accept that much. Files this size are uploaded over SFTP.
files.backTitle: Back (or the «back» button on your mouse)
files.forwardTitle: Forward (or the «forward» button on your mouse)
files.confirmClose: Changes are not saved. Close anyway?
files.truncated: The file is too large and is shown only partly — saving is disabled, otherwise the rest would be wiped.
files.renameHint: You can give a path — then the file moves: for example /plugins/old.yml
schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.noSteps: No steps — this schedule does nothing.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.skipOffline: Skip if the server is off
schedules.ignore: What to leave out of the backup (optional)
schedules.delayHint: Needed when the previous step starts something: for example, to let the server shut down before a backup.
schedules.continueOnFail: Continue even if the step fails
address.unknown: Address unknown — sync the server list with Pterodactyl.
stats.unavailable: Statistics unavailable: Pterodactyl is not responding, or the service account has no access to this server.
